quotes.text: found favour in thy sight, pass not away, 1 pray thee, from thy servant : Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort yoyour hearts ; after that ye shall pass on: for, therefore are ye come to your servant. And 1 they said, So do, as thou hast said.”
